NOTICE OF ADVERSE DETERMINATION - MEDICAL NECESSITY

This letter constitutes an adverse determination based on medical necessity for the service identified above. Following review of the submitted medical record by a physician reviewer, Northgate Advantage has determined that the requested inpatient level of service does not meet the applicable medical necessity criteria. The medical record does not document clinical severity sufficient to require inpatient admission.

CRITERIA REVIEWED AND FINDINGS

COPD-01: Not met. Oxygenation was near baseline and did not require inpatient care.

COPD-02: Not met. Symptoms improved with emergency department treatment.

No other criteria were applied in reaching this determination.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

The following codes will appear on the associated remittance advice for claim CLM00918786035:

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY

Because this determination is based on medical necessity, payment for the inpatient admission billed under DRG 192 for the period [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] is denied. The member is not liable for charges denied under the codes referenced above where contractual provisions apply.

APPEAL RIGHTS AND INSTRUCTIONS

A reconsideration request may be submitted within the applicable filing window. The submission must include a written clinical rationale that maps each finding stated in this notice to the corresponding numbered criterion referenced above. Supporting documentation from the medical record should be attached and indexed to each criterion addressed.

Level of care denials are not eligible for provider appeal.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Requests received after that deadline may be closed without clinical review.

A peer-to-peer discussion with the reviewing physician may be requested through the Utilization Management Department prior to the deadline stated above. Requests for a copy of the specific criteria applied in this review may be made in writing.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
